response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but their profile is fundamentally misaligned with this role. Professional C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015, far short of the mandatory 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++ development. There is no SQL Server or Oracle experience listed (only MongoDB/MySQL), and no capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking domain exposure — RIDE Capital was a fintech startup working in Node/TypeScript, not a capital markets environment. The low-latency systems background in DLang shows relevant fundamentals, but the gaps on all three mandatory requirements are too large.
strengths: Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (DLang micro-services handling millions of requests/sec)
Solid engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, DevOps tooling
Broad polyglot experience with some C/C++ exposure and strong communication (workshops, talks)
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ experience, versus the mandatory 5–10 years on Windows
No fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain knowledge
No SQL Server or Oracle experience; recent career trajectory is TypeScript/Node web development

key_factors.factor: No capital markets / fixed income domain expertise
